title: Dashboard variable
description: A value the viewer picks for the whole dashboard, such as a period: a choice from a list of options. A request names the variable to put its current value into a query or body key; the dashboard root draws the control above the grid and re-runs only the cells whose request names it. The root checks that the option values are unique and that the default is one of them.

title.description: The control's visible label and accessible name.

options.description: The options in display order. Values are unique: the root fails the dashboard load on a repeated value.

default.description: The value the dashboard starts with: one of the option values. The root fails the dashboard load otherwise.

option.description: One option of the list: the value that goes into the request and the text the control shows.
